B.text: If the blue Rest of the world series and red U.S. series use vertically comparable 2020 value scales, then the series whose 2020 mark is higher on the plot has the larger reported value; the task directs opening that region's follow-up record.
B.conditions: This requires that the colored axis labels bind blue to Rest of the world and red to U.S., and that the two differently placed vertical axes are comparable for ranking. No numeric tick labels or 2020 point labels are visible to verify cross-axis comparability.
